task.question: What position did Keir Starmer resign from on June 22, 2026 in the United Kingdom?
task.evidence: June 22 – Following months of criticism and pressure, Keir Starmer resigned as prime minister of the United Kingdom. Starmer later resigned his membership as Member of Parliament to assume his role as member of the Chiltern Hundreds on September 1.

answer: FINAL: On June 22, 2026, Keir Starmer resigned from his position as British Prime Minister (and leader of the Labour Party).
